name: git
description: Selected inspection commands for Git repositories. This is a partial community schema, not a CLI Spec conformance claim.

global_args.name: --no-optional-locks
global_args.description: Disable optional operations that require locks; use for status inspection.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Inspect staged, unstaged, and untracked changes. Use --no-optional-locks to avoid the optional index refresh.

commands.name: log
commands.description: Inspect commit history. Bound results with -n and disable pagers for unattended use.
